# Radoslav Radev Lays Out Six Weekly Levels From Tuck Planche To Straddle Planche

Radoslav Radev gives six levels to go through, one per week, from tuck to half tuck up to straddle planche. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:15]

## Details

- Week one is tuck to half tuck. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:15]
- Week two is half tuck to advanced tuck planche. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:21]
- Week three is advanced tuck planche to frog stand with raised legs. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:21] [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:26]
- Week four is frog stand with raised legs to pike straddle planche. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:26]
- Week five is pike straddle planche to half pike straddle planche. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:31]
- Week six is half pike straddle planche to straddle planche. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:31] [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:36]
